title: Project P.I.T.T. Secret Ending Guide — END?, Elevator Code & Route
description: END? is the game’s Secret Ending label according to newer achievement information. The verified route progresses in this order: camera / surveillance progression → upper exploration → Mystery Boxes → 3 Fuses → 200kg → Percentage Pipe → later minigame / production progression → UV-related clue progression → elevator access / keycard → save-specific four-digit keypad code → Secret Ending route. The four-digit code is tied to your save and discovered with UV clues; it corresponds to the four manual production machines and must be entered in the machine-unlock order Duck → Cash Register → Piñata → Anomaly. Keycard steps and prior progression stages must be completed to access the elevator and keypad; UV is part of finding the hidden digits. Community reports include one playthrough code of 2640, but that is from a specific save and is not a universal answer — many players report 2640 does not work. If you are stuck, return to the last progression stage you completed (for example check UV clues, keycard steps, or the minigame/production tasks) rather than trying an internet-wide code.
h1: Project P.I.T.T. Secret Ending Guide — END?, Elevator Code & Route
quickAnswer: END? = the Secret Ending. Follow the verified progression through surveillance → upper areas → Mystery Boxes → fuses → 200kg → Percentage Pipe → production/minigame → UV clues → elevator/keycard → save-specific 4-digit keypad → Secret Ending. The four digits are found with UV in your save, correspond to the four manual production machines, and must be entered in Duck → Cash Register → Piñata → Anomaly order. 2640 is a code reported from one specific playthrough and is not guaranteed to work for everyone; many players report 2640 does not work.

facts.label: What END? is
facts.value: END? is the Secret Ending label indicated by newer achievement information; do not conflate END? with other ending labels from older guides.

facts.label: Verified route stages
facts.value: camera / surveillance progression → upper exploration → Mystery Boxes → 3 Fuses → 200kg → Percentage Pipe → later minigame / production progression → UV-related clue progression → elevator access / keycard → save-specific four-digit keypad code → Secret Ending route.

facts.label: Four-digit keypad rule
facts.value: The four-digit keypad code is save-specific and must be found using UV clues in your own playthrough. The digits correspond to the four manual production machines and must be entered in this machine order: Duck → Cash Register → Piñata → Anomaly. A code such as 2640 has been reported from one playthrough only and should not be treated as universal; current player reports include that 2640 does not work for many saves.

facts.label: Why players lose the thread and troubleshooting
facts.value: Common fail points are missing UV clues, incomplete keycard steps, or skipping production/minigame progression. Elevator/keypad access requires completing the keycard progression and the UV-related clues. If stuck, go back to the last verified progression stage you completed instead of trying to brute-force an internet code or assuming a universal elevator code.
